messages.subject: GCC Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Al-Adawy,

Your GCC recruitment work across energy, utilities, renewables and infrastructure, including senior and executive mandates throughout the Middle East, makes this a particularly relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major natural-resources operation.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments, with Saudi Arabia as my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC. My strongest fit sits where energy or resources strategy depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline, responsible development and coordinated execution across corporate, technical and public-sector stakeholders.

I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate assignments. My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for appropriate current or future mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
